records.claim: Writing was invented independently three or four times: four if Egypt counts, three if Egypt borrowed the idea from Mesopotamia

The Cascajal block from the Olmec heartland is the oldest writing in the Americas, dated by style to the early first millennium BCE

records.claim: Khipus recorded census and tribute counts, and may have encoded tributaries' names by colour
